trimmed_dict.title: Parking Lot 40 (Lower Seigfred) Partial Closure
trimmed_dict.description:
Ohio University Transportation & Parking Services would like to notify the community of the following upcoming parking lot closure:

 

A portion of Parking Lot 40 (Lower Seigfred)  will be closing at 5:00 AM Monday August 4th, 2025 to accommodate construction occurring within the area. The parking area is planned to re-open in late 2026. 

 

Any vehicles remaining within the parking area at 5:00 AM Monday August 4th, 2025 are subject for citation and/or relocation at the owners expense.
